extraction.Name: Rose Elizabeth Larvie Breast
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not want this patent but it was issued without my asking for it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Thomas Larvie, my uncle told me that if I did not sell the land that I would have to pay tax
extraction.NOTES: Sold land for $1100.00; received patent approximately 10 years prior to testimony, obtained from the farmer at the Black Pipe station and signed receipt before the farmer at Wanblee; has six living children with her; supported by herself and husband; states she is not in good health; document notarized June 4, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32
